newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WELSH UNCHANGED FOR IRISH VISIT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELSH UNCHANGED FOR IRISH VISIT.

text.p: Wales have named an unchanged team to face Ireland at home in the Five Nations championship on February 1.
The 34-19 win over Scotland last weekend allowed Welsh coach Kevin Bowring the luxury of announcing the same side in consecutive tests for the first time in 11 matches.
Ireland have not lost on the last six visits to Cardiff.

Teams: 15-Neil Jenkins; 14-Ieuan Evans, 13-Allan Bateman, 12-Scott Gibbs, 11-Gareth Thomas; 10-Arwel Thomas, 9-Rob Howley; 8-Scott Quinnell, 7-Colin Charvis, 6-Steve Williams, 5-Mark Rowley, 4-Gareth Llewellyn, 3-David Young, 2-Jonathan Humphreys (captain), 1-Christian Loader.
